name: paper-screenprint
note: Read by eye. keep = how it is made (copied verbatim); replace is set per slide.
keep: KEEP — the making of the image, copy exactly:
· MEDIUM: hand-pulled silkscreen on heavy cream paper. Untouched paper margin on all four edges, ~4% of the frame, slightly uneven, with a faint plate impression.
· GROUND: one mottled, sponged, blotchy ink field — uneven density, lighter in the centre, denser at the edges, paper tooth showing through. NOT a flat digital fill, NOT a gradient.
· SHAPES: flat cut-and-torn paper shapes with angular hand-cut edges, small facets and nicks. Inside them: pure blank unprinted paper — zero shading, zero detail, zero rendering.
· FRAGMENTS: only small collaged pieces are photographic — coarse grainy high-contrast black-and-white halftone from an old print.
· REGISTRATION: a thin 1-2px yellow and cyan halo along part of each boundary where the screens missed.
· No text, no signature, no numbers, no logo anywhere.
